title: Playa de Mai-a | KEY.co
description_expanded: Nestled in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach along the iconic 30A, this extraordinary home redefines luxury coastal living. A wall of glass doors seamlessly connects the indoors to an expansive outdoor oasis, complete with a sparkling pool, spa, and entertainment space designed to inspire relaxation and unforgettable moments. Inside, the soaring ceilings and open-concept design create an airy, inviting atmosphere where natural light floods the chef’s dream kitchen, featuring an eight-burner gas stove, double ovens, and dual refrigerators. With ample seating for large gatherings, including a six-seat kitchen island, dining table for eight, and bar seating for three, every meal becomes a cherished experience. Ideal for corporate retreats, family reunions, or multi-family vacations, this stunning six-bedroom, six-and-a-half-bathroom retreat comfortably accommodates up to twenty guests. Designed with both entertainment and relaxation in mind, the home offers abundant space to connect and unwind. For boating enthusiasts, its proximity to Choctawhatchee Bay and the Gulf of Mexico promises unparalleled fishing adventures and aquatic exploration. Whether basking in luxury poolside or embarking on a coastal adventure, this exceptional Blue Mountain Beach haven delivers the perfect blend of sophistication, comfort, and unforgettable memories.
